title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Report/source describe compressible NS and nondimensionalization.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS unstructured geometry and boundary-family handling are source-supported.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Face-based conservative residual assembly is source-supported.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Implemented flux needs independent numerical verification; report calls it Roe but source inspection is the primary evidence.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip, and no-slip paths are present.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Least-squares reconstruction exists but production steady runs hold limiter phi at zero through startup_steps=100000; transient explicitly zeros phi.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Venkatakrishnan limiter is computed but disabled for all documented production paths.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Newtonian/Fourier and wall treatment are source-supported.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: LU-SGS pseudo-time path and CFL logic are source-supported.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF2 dual-time source path exists, but no retained Re200 output proves production controls or inner convergence.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: Source supports METIS partitions and neighbor halos; retained delivered evidence cannot verify rank consistency.

disqualification_flags.text: second-order reconstruction or shock limiter disabled for production cases
disqualification_flags.evidence: solver.cpp lines 421-423 sets startup_steps=100000 and scales phi to zero; lines 530 and 558 explicitly zero phi in transient. report.tex lines 193-196 admits first-order production mode.
